record.issue_text: In refreshOAuthTokens.ts:8-14, response.ok is never checked on the credential-sync response, so a 4xx/5xx (or an HTML error page) is passed downstream and treated as a token payload by callers

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when credential sync is enabled it does `const response = await fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and immediately `return response;` with no `response.ok` (or status/content-type) validation. Callers then assume a successful token response path; e.g. in `googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the returned value is treated like an axios-style object (`const token = res?.data; googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token;`), so a 4xx/5xx (or non-JSON body) from the sync endpoint will flow downstream and can be misinterpreted / cause runtime failures rather than being handled as an error at the boundary.
